authorInspection.method: Each compact line is one complete parsed/reserialized family/character with all restrictions/flags/senses. Specified compact ranges returned without truncation. Semantic-equivalence audit binds compact lines to original frozen entries. Author inspection, not independent review or comprehension certification.
authorInspection.primaryArticleNavigation: Full word metadata scan found only真剣 containing/declaratively mapping剣; exactしんけん identity and N3 level inspected. No剣/つるぎ article. Current検 kanji and本気 word absent: inventory absence, not permission denial.
authorInspection.publicSourceScope: Actual Digital Daijisenけん【剣】/つるぎ【剣】/漢字項目 and真剣 inspected. Character heading explicitly assigns真剣 toケン;つるぎ heading and generic sword definition establish useful native reading without exclusive blade taxonomy. Historical, place, train and product entries kept separate; no etymology or historical classification adopted.
